title: sneed-and-feed/lean-theorems-1
summary: A comprehensive, machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the Erdős–Szekeres Convex Polygon Theorem (1935). Formalizes orientation determinants, general position, 2D rotation transformations with finite slope avoidance (rotating any finite set to have mutually distinct x-coordinates), x-coordinate sorting, cup-cap sequences with Pascal-type binomial split recurrences, halfspace separation for convex hulls, and rotation invariance of convex polygons.
